measurement_limits: Finite workloads differ; no matched throughput or latency ranking.
Delugi preloaded fixture reports no transaction latency.
Raptr latency is origin-local monotonic admission to first actual application append; no cross-host clock subtraction.
Raptr native verifier authenticates observer journals, transactions and exact payload/order; raw native QC bytes are absent.
Traffic endpoints differ: Delugi fully drains; Raptr freezes before shutdown.
